text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm holding PR-16821 from landing. CI put the stress-matrix group into quarantine after the latest run and I'd rather not attempt a full merge during the deploy freeze window tonight at 21:00 UTC. Can @ajay and @sophia give quick eyes/approval if we get a green rerun? If green I'll queue it into the staged merge window that opens an hour before freeze only for canary traffic.

ajay: On it. Which job flaked exactly? I can kick a targeted retry.

maria: `stress-matrix::shard-7` failing with an OOM; looks intermittent. Please run `/ci retry PR-16821 --jobs=stress-matrix::shard-7` and paste the driver logs if it fails again.

sophia: Will take a look after lunch, but +1 to holding if the stress tests are flaky. We don't want a rollback during freeze. :no_entry_sign: 

ci-bot: CI status for PR-16821 — run 4872: stress-matrix::shard-7 FAILED, other jobs PASSED. Retry available. (link: https://ci.internal/runs/4872)

ajay: kicked the targeted retry: `/ci retry PR-16821 --jobs=stress-matrix::shard-7` — rerun id 4873.

ci-bot: Rerun 4873 — stress-matrix::shard-7 PASSED. Full pipeline now running (expect ~12m).

kevin: If the pipeline stays green I can do post-merge smoke tests at 20:30 UTC and hold traffic until you confirm canary metrics. Will be available.

maria: Great — thanks @kevin. @sophia if you can approve once the full pipeline is green that should be enough for me to request a staged merge slot. Also note: we can't rebase during the DB migration window from 22:00-23:00 UTC, so aim to land before that, or we'll need to delay to tomorrow.

sophia: Saw green on the full pipeline now. Leaving one inline comment (naming nit) but it's non-blocking. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

release-bot: Staged merge request created for PR-16821 — slot tentative at 20:45 UTC (will become final once manual confirm from maria).

maria: Confirming — please finalise the staged merge at 20:45 UTC if no regressions appear in canary. I'll monitor the canary dashboards for 30m after traffic shift. If anything spikes, we abort and hold for manual rollback.

ajay: Thanks, queued. If the stress tests reappear flaky let's add a temporary quarantine exemption and re-run only prod-like shards.

maria: Noted. For now: hold -> rerun -> green -> approve -> staged merge at 20:45 UTC -> canary watch. I'll post a short update in #general after the canary window. :eyes:
